Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document shows the protective maintenance which must be 
 performed annually on the thrust bearing oil circulation pump 
 as indicated by Y1 
 in the title block.
This pump function is to pumped the oil through the oil 
 cooling system the technical specification of the oil pump
capacity Q | : | 300 
 L/m
pressure p | : | 5.2 
 bar
speed N |  | 3000 
 rpm
power | : | 7.5 kw
This document is initiated and 
 tested by eng. Ahmed Abdel Qader Mahmoud, revised by eng. Abdel Gwad Yosef Mohamed, accepted by eng. Ebrahim 
 Abdel Rahman Ahmad general manager, and approved by eng. Khalaf Allah 
 Mahmoud Abd El gaber head sector of Aswan Hydraulic power station and certified by eng. Mohammed Osama Solima

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc
Maintenance staff should be well 
 trained & qualified or directly
Supervised by some one
Switch off pump
Close the inlet and out let 
 valves
Tools 
and Equipment
Set wrenches and screwdrivers
Kerosene and cleaning material 
 (rag. cloth)
Work to be 
carried out
Vent all pressure from pump housing
Disassembly the inlet and out let junction
Revision pump from driver motor and remove coupling from pump
Disassembly the pump parts
Inspect O-rings, mechanical seal, ball bearing and packing
Replace when the parts have been disturbed from their original installed 
 position
Clean and coated all internal and rotating parts with lubricated oil before 
 assembly
Assembly the pump and mounted on its place
Assembly the inlet and out let junction and the coupling on the pump
Align the pump .
